candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (Public Procurement Office tender search)
candidates.why_relevant: Central national search over all Slovak public procurement notices. Filtering by contracting authority (NBS, MF SR, Štátna pokladnica, state banks) and by CPV codes for software/consulting surfaces tender texts that name the regulation being implemented (DORA, PSD2/PSD3, AML, IFRS/FINREP-COREP reporting) and its compliance deadline, typically months before public announcement.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for search
candidates.legal_status: official public register under Act 343/2015 Z.z.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scraping of the search UI filtered by contracting authority + CPV (72xxxxxx IT services, 66xxxxxx financial services); parse notice title, CPV, estimated value, deadlines; snowball to full notice documents.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search on ÚVO + vestník verejného obstarávania
queries_used: ÚVO Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie vestník verejného obstarávania Národná banka Slovenska zákazka

candidates.source_name: Vestník verejného obstarávania (ÚVO Public Procurement Bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: The official daily bulletin of procurement notices submitted via the eForms system. It is the authoritative, dated publication stream — ideal as a daily-diff feed for new notices from financial-sector public bodies; the publication date anchors a timeline of upcoming regulatory implementations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of bulletin issues; keyword filter on sk terms (dohľad, platobný systém, reporting, AML, kybernetická bezpečnosť) and on issuing authority names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania

candidates.source_name: ÚVO profil verejného obstarávateľa – Národná banka Slovenska (profile #8643)
candidates.why_relevant: The single highest-value profile in this cell: all NBS procurement documents in one place. NBS is both central bank and integrated financial supervisor, so its IT/consulting tenders directly reveal which supervisory, reporting, resolution or payment-oversight obligations it is building for and by when.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the profile listing for new zákazky; download attached tender documentation (súťažné podklady, opis predmetu zákazky) which contains the regulatory justification text.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search + snowball from NBS website
queries_used: ÚVO profil verejného obstarávateľa Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS – Verejné obstarávanie / Profil verejného obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: NBS's own procurement hub, confirming it runs above-threshold tenders through IS JOSEPHINE and linking to sub-sections for selected tenders, contracts/orders/invoices, and preparatory market consultations. Gives the routing map for where NBS demand signals appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the three sub-pages (verejne-sutaze, zmluvy-objednavky-faktury, pripravne-trhove-konzultacie) on a weekly cadence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of NBS procurement page
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil

candidates.source_name: NBS – Prípravné trhové konzultácie (preparatory market consultations)
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest-possible signal in the procurement lifecycle. A PTK is published before a tender exists and describes the intended system and the driving obligation — this is where a future supervisory-reporting or payments-oversight requirement first becomes visible in writing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly diff of the page; archive each PTK document and extract the stated legal basis and target go-live date.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NBS procurement hub fetch
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska prípravné trhové konzultácie

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (Slovakia filter)
candidates.why_relevant: All above-threshold Slovak notices are mirrored to TED in structured eForms XML, with English summaries. Better machine-readability and cross-border comparability than ÚVO — lets the same regulatory-driven tender be compared against peer central banks/supervisors in CZ, PL, HU.
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication (OJ supplement), explicitly designed for reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search API expert queries filtered on country=SVK plus buyer name/CPV; daily incremental pull.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search
queries_used: TED tenders europa Slovakia National Bank of Slovakia procurement notice supervision

candidates.source_name: TED Search API / bulk XML packages
candidates.why_relevant: The programmable ingestion path for the whole cell. Documented, unauthenticated, supports expert queries, pagination up to 15k docs and an unlimited paging token, plus daily/monthly bulk XML packages — the cheapest way to build a persistent longitudinal index of SK financial-sector tenders.
candidates.access_status: public API, no auth required per documentation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Nightly Search API job with a stored expert query; fall back to monthly bulk packages for backfill.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search on TED developer documentation
queries_used: TED europa API developer docs search notices JSON bulk download eForms

candidates.source_name: IS EVO / Elektronická platforma verejného obstarávania (EPVO) – portál zákaziek
candidates.why_relevant: The state-operated e-procurement platform (transferred to the Government Office in March 2022) through which many public bodies actually run procedures. Its public order search exposes tender documentation and Q&A ('vysvetlenia') that often contain the most explicit statements of regulatory scope and deadline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the public OrderSearch listing; download attached documentation where the platform allows anonymous access.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on IS EVO / EPVO
queries_used: EVO elektronické verejné obstarávanie IS EVO elektronická platforma Slovensko obstarávanie

candidates.source_name: JOSEPHINE (PROEBIZ) – public tenders list, used by NBS
candidates.why_relevant: NBS's own procurement page states that its above-threshold tenders are conducted via IS JOSEPHINE. The platform's public tender list therefore carries NBS (and other financial bodies') live tender records and attached documentation, sometimes visible earlier or in fuller form than the ÚVO profile.
candidates.access_status: public listing; document download typically requires free registration
candidates.legal_status: private platform hosting mandatory public disclosures; check ToS before automated access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public-tenders list filtered by promoter=Národná banka Slovenska; manual/low-rate document retrieval to respect ToS.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NBS procurement page mention of IS JOSEPHINE
queries_used: JOSEPHINE proebiz verejné obstarávanie Slovensko zverejnené zákazky

candidates.source_name: EKS – Elektronický kontraktačný systém / elektronické trhovisko
candidates.why_relevant: Central electronic marketplace for below-threshold contracts and dynamic purchasing systems. Small advisory, legal-analysis and reporting-tool purchases by ministries and supervisors land here rather than on TED — a low-value but high-frequency early indicator of regulatory workstreams.
candidates.access_status: public browsing of orders; ordering requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword search over published orders (zákazky) for financial-regulation terms; capture buyer, description, value, dates.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search
queries_used: Elektronický kontraktačný systém eks.sk elektronické trhovisko zákazky zverejňovanie

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register where every contract of ministries, central state bodies and public-law institutions must be published to take effect (Act 546/2010). Signed contract texts are far more explicit than notices: scope of work, milestone dates, named regulations, and the vendor actually delivering the supervisory/reporting system.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filter by resort/organisation (MF SR, ÚVO, Štátna pokladnica, DataCentrum) and by keyword; download contract PDFs and extract milestones.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on register zmlúv
queries_used: Ministerstvo financií SR verejné obstarávanie profil ÚVO register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluvy

candidates.source_name: UVOstat – aggregated ÚVO + CRZ analytics and API
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party aggregator joining procurement notices, the contract register and buyer-supplier relationships into one queryable dataset with an API. Dramatically reduces the cost of longitudinal analysis (who supplies NBS/MF SR regulatory IT, at what cadence).
candidates.access_status: partly free; API requires an ApiToken header, /api/subjekty free for registered users, other endpoints paid
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication of open data; derivative — verify against ÚVO/CRZ primary
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for an API token; use as a discovery/index layer only, always re-verifying critical facts against the ÚVO or CRZ primary record.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search for procurement aggregators
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejných obstarávaní Slovensko API otvorené dáta
candidates.observed_blocker: Documentation indicates most API endpoints require a paid ApiToken; unauthenticated calls return 401.

candidates.source_name: Verejné súťaže portal (EPVO + EKS + ÚVO aggregation)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates tenders from EPVO, EKS, ZNH and ÚVO into one searchable feed, useful as a cross-check that no channel was missed. Individual tender pages (e.g. ÚVO IT staffing and IS upgrade contracts) are indexed and readable.
candidates.access_status: basic features free after registration; premium paid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a coverage cross-check rather than a primary feed; sample its listings against ÚVO to detect gaps in own collection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search for aggregators
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejných obstarávaní Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Tender.sk – commercial tender intelligence platform (SK + abroad)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial platform with CPV/region/buyer/keyword search and an integration API. Its taxonomy and saved-search alerting can be used to prototype the CPV filter set before building in-house ingestion from ÚVO/TED.
candidates.access_status: free trial; subscription for full access and API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Optional subscription for alerting; not recommended as a system-of-record.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search for aggregators
queries_used: agregátor verejných obstarávaní Slovensko API

candidates.source_name: MetaIS – Centrálny metainformačný systém verejnej správy (register of public-administration IT systems and projects)
candidates.why_relevant: Upstream of procurement: public bodies must register planned IT assets, project intents (projektový zámer) and change requests here before tendering, under Vyhláška 401/2023 Z.z. on IT project management. A registered ISVS or projektový zámer for a supervisory/reporting system is the earliest structured evidence that an obligation is being operationalised, with its planned timeline.
candidates.access_status: public browsing of ISVS and project records
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search ISVS/project records by owning authority (MF SR, MIRRI, NBS-linked bodies) and by keyword; capture projektový zámer documents and planned milestones.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search, inferred from first principles (who must register before they can procure)
queries_used: MetaIS register projektov informačných systémov verejnej správy Ministerstvo financií

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR – Centrálny register zmlúv resort view
candidates.why_relevant: MF SR is the transposing ministry for EU financial-services directives. Its contracts for legal analyses, transposition studies and impact assessments name the directive being transposed and the transposition deadline — often before any public consultation opens.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginate the resort listing; keyword-filter contract subjects for smernica/nariadenie/transpozícia/analýza.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search + snowball
queries_used: Ministerstvo financií SR verejné obstarávanie register zmlúv

candidates.source_name: Open Data MF SR (opendata.mfsr.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Finance open-data portal; useful for machine-readable budget/contract/organisation datasets that let procurement records be joined to budget lines, indicating the scale and timing of a regulatory implementation programme.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate available datasets; ingest those covering contracts, organisations and budget programmes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search snowball from MF SR

candidates.source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – Profil verejného obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: State export-import bank; a contracting authority whose IT and compliance tenders (AML/CFT screening, sanctions, reporting) reveal which prudential and financial-crime obligations state-linked lenders are implementing and on what schedule.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic page diff; cross-check against its ÚVO profile for full documentation.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on state financial bodies

candidates.why_relevant: State-owned NPL/receivables consolidation company. Its procurement reveals state handling of distressed financial assets and any data/reporting systems it must build — an indirect but distinctive read on receivables and recovery regulation.
candidates.access_status: public; site appears to serve over plain HTTP
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page diff; supplement via CRZ and the ÚVO profile.

candidates.source_name: Štátna pokladnica – CRZ contract listing
candidates.why_relevant: The State Treasury operates core payment and settlement infrastructure for the public sector. Its contracts and tenders track payment-scheme migrations (SEPA/ISO 20022, instant payments) and their mandated cut-over dates — a direct read on payments-regulation timing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the CRZ organisation page plus its ÚVO profile; extract payment-infrastructure contract scopes and milestone dates.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on state financial bodies

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vestník a Registre (registers hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub for all registers ÚVO maintains under Act 343/2015 (bulletin, profiles, register of final beneficial owners / partners of the public sector). Beyond tender discovery, this supports vendor due-diligence and mapping who actually supplies regulatory systems to the Slovak financial state.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the register list once; wire only the registers that add ownership/eligibility data to the vendor map.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search

negative_findings.description: Searching TED in English for National Bank of Slovakia supervision-related notices returned only generic TED explainer pages and two unrelated notice PDFs, no confirmed NBS supervisory-IT notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: General TED documentation surfaced; no specific SK financial-supervision tender identified through the general web search layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that general web search is the wrong instrument for this cell — TED's own Search API with buyer/CPV filters must be used rather than relying on indexed pages. Absence here is a search-method limitation, not evidence that such tenders do not exist.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public procurement profile page was located for Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka (SZRB), Fond ochrany vkladov or Garančný fond investícií within this run's searches; only a Wikipedia entry surfaced for SZRB.
negative_findings.result_summary: SZRB, FOV and GFI procurement pages not confirmed at a specific URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are exactly the state-linked financial bodies the cell targets. Their profiles almost certainly exist on ÚVO (profile search by name) but were not confirmed here, so no URL is asserted rather than inventing one.

negative_findings.description: UVOstat's API requires an ApiToken header; only /api/subjekty is free for registered users and other endpoints are paid, per its own documentation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregator API is paywalled beyond one endpoint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/dependency risk if the pipeline is designed around the aggregator; the free ÚVO/TED/CRZ primaries should remain the system of record.

negative_findings.description: No page fetch was attempted against uvo.gov.sk, ted.europa.eu, evo.isepvo.sk, josephine.proebiz.com, eks.sk, crz.gov.sk or metais during this run beyond the single NBS fetch; all other URLs come from search-result listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded from search indexes with stated confidence; liveness not asserted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must confirm reachability; several Slovak state portals have been restructured (uvo.gov.sk has both legacy '-4dd.html' and modern '/vyhladavanie/' URL forms), so redirects are expected rather than dead links.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurement profiles for second-tier state-linked financial actors (SZRB, Eximbanka's ÚVO profile ID, Fond ochrany vkladov, Garančný fond investícií, Sociálna poisťovňa's II-pillar systems, DataCentrum) were not individually resolved to ÚVO profile IDs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run ÚVO profile search (https://www.uvo.gov.sk/vyhladavanie/vyhladavanie-profilov) for each actor name and record the numeric profile ID, as was done for NBS (8643), so each becomes a stable watchable endpoint.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code set has been fixed for this cell, so tender filtering is currently keyword-based and will be noisy.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a CPV whitelist (72000000 IT services, 72200000 software programming/consultancy, 66000000 financial and insurance services, 79400000 business/management consultancy, 79140000 legal advisory) and combine with buyer filters on TED and ÚVO.

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language coverage was achieved for procurement portals and actors, but no Slovak glossary was built for the regulatory subject-matter terms that would appear inside tender descriptions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test a sk keyword list against ÚVO full-text search: dohľad nad finančným trhom, obozretné podnikanie, platobné služby, prevádzková odolnosť (DORA), ochrana pred legalizáciou príjmov z trestnej činnosti (AML), vykazovanie/reporting, kybernetická bezpečnosť, transpozícia smernice, konzultačný dokument.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical backfill strategy is defined; only forward-looking monitoring is described.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use TED monthly bulk XML packages plus CRZ resort listings for a 3-5 year backfill, to establish the normal lead time between tender publication and regulatory deadline for SK financial bodies — the baseline that makes future notices interpretable.

coverage_gaps.description: Documentation attached to tenders (súťažné podklady, opis predmetu zákazky, vysvetlenia) — where the regulatory justification actually lives — often sits behind platform registration on JOSEPHINE and EPVO.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test anonymous document download on both platforms; if registration is required, decide whether a registered read-only account is acceptable under their ToS before building automation.

brief: Slovak procurement intelligence for banking/payments runs through a small, well-defined stack: ÚVO (vestník, tender search, and per-authority profiles — NBS is profile 8643) as the national primary, TED with its unauthenticated Search API and bulk eForms packages as the machine-readable EU mirror, and the Centrálny register zmlúv for signed contract texts that state scope, vendor and milestone dates far more explicitly than notices do. Execution is split across platforms: NBS runs above-threshold tenders through IS JOSEPHINE, other bodies through the state EPVO/IS EVO platform, and below-threshold purchases through the EKS marketplace, so a single-portal watch will miss material. The highest-leverage early signals sit upstream of tendering — NBS 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' and MetaIS project intents registered under Vyhláška 401/2023 — where an obligation is described in writing before any notice is published. Aggregators (UVOstat, verejnesutaze.sk, tender.sk) are useful discovery and cross-check layers but are derivative and partly paywalled, so the free state and EU primaries should remain the system of record.
